d:
devauthni ekadshi, tulsi vivah evan shri khatu shyam ji ke janmotsav ke pavan avsar par prastut hai bhaktimay bhajnon ka yah vishesh sankalna.
Devauthni ekadshi ka parv bhagvan shri hari vishnu ke yognidra se jagrit hone ka shubh avsar hai. is din bhagvan vishnu ki puja-archana evan bhajan-kirtan ka vishesh mahatv hai.
Tulsi vivah ke pavan parv par mata tulsi aur bhagvan shaligram ke divy vivah ka utsav shraddha aur bhakti ke sath manaya jata hai. tulsi mata ki aaradhna se bhakt apne jivan aur parivar ke lie sukh-shanti evan samriddhi ki kamna karte hain.
